rule: Log every intentional change to the weekly ledger history/YYYY-Www.md.
ai_action: Append What/Why/Refs for substantial changes, a one-liner for minor ones. Skip trivial typo/whitespace edits.
risk_weight_note: Below the accountability band (8-10). The band is written for a fleet where a missing audit trail means nobody can be identified afterwards. Here there is one operator and git already records who changed what; a missed ledger entry costs traceability of intent, which is recoverable by reading the diff. Weight left at the honest assessment rather than raised to clear the band.
